newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index rises in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index rises in brisk trade.

text.p: Nigeria's share index rose in brisk Tuesday trading after dropping back on Monday due to profit taking, dealers said.
The index closed at 6,623.78 from 6,620.79 on Monday.
Union Dicon Salt rose 75 kobo to 37.50 naira on its improved trading result announced on Tuesday. Nestle Foods rose 30 kobo to 38.00 naira.
Oil marketing company Total, which reported a drop in profits on Monday, rose 10 kobo to 49.15 naira.
Mobil climbed 35 kobo to 41.85 naira. Unipetrol and National Oil each gained 20 kobo to close at 44.40 naira and 37.10 naira respectively.
West African Portland Cement added 20 kobo to close at 36.50 naira.
AIICO Insurance gained 10 kobo to 7.70 naira. Royal Exchange Assurance added five kobo to 2.50 naira, while Niger Insurance advanced two kobo to 2.55 naira.
Cadbury dropped 30 kobo to 26.00 naira. Nigerian Breweries went down 10 kobo to 11.00 naira and Guinness lost the same amount at 7.20 naira.
Tyre maker Dunlop finished five kobo down at 10.85 naira.
Afribank was five kobo down at 5.10 naira.
There was heavy trading in other bank shares but prices were stable.
Guaranty Trust Bank shares traded steady at 14.10 naira after annoucing a slight improvement in half-year profits.
"It is a satisfactory result given the prevailing economic environment," said Bolaji Balogun, chief executive of CSL Stockbrokers.
